# monotaur_notification_escalation_step (Resource)

Manages one escalation step of a Monotaur notification policy. When an alarm the policy matches is still open and unacknowledged `delay_minutes` after it was reported, the step's channels are notified. A policy's steps fire in order of their delay, and two steps of a policy cannot share a delay. Deleting the policy deletes its steps.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "monotaur_notification_channel" "team_lead" {
  name        = "Team lead"
  type        = "Webhook"
  event_types = ["com.monotaur.alarm.triggered", "com.monotaur.alarm.cleared"]
  credential  = "https://hooks.example.com/team-lead"
}

resource "monotaur_notification_policy" "production" {
  name             = "Production on-call"
  minimum_severity = "Error"
}

# Notify the team lead if an alarm the policy matches is still
# unacknowledged 30 minutes after it was reported.
resource "monotaur_notification_escalation_step" "team_lead" {
  notification_policy_id = monotaur_notification_policy.production.id
  delay_minutes          = 30
  channel_ids            = [monotaur_notification_channel.team_lead.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `channel_ids` (List of String) IDs of the notification channels the step notifies. At least one is required. A channel only receives escalations if it subscribes to `com.monotaur.alarm.triggered`.
- `delay_minutes` (Number) Minutes (1 to 10080) after the alarm was reported that the step fires. Counted from the alarm, not from the previous step; unique within the policy.
- `notification_policy_id` (String) The ID of the notification policy the step belongs to. Changing it replaces the step.

### Read-Only

- `create_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the step was created (assigned by the API).
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the escalation step (assigned by the API).
- `update_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the step was last updated (assigned by the API).
